text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: Graduates can work as practical personnel in enterprise, institution and administrative management of relevant department. This program cultivates students with good science accomplishment, helps master basic theory, knowledge and skills of computer hardware and software, and also equips students with a strong design and application ability on computer system analysis. Graduates can work as practical personnel with innovative spirit on research and development of computer application technology in enterprise, institution and administrative management of relevant department. 2. The Model of the Program Editor Notes: The model of this program is 2+2, namely in the first two years the courses are delivered in English while in the last two years international students take classes in Chinese. It takes 4 years to complete this program generally; however it can be extended to 6 years at most. In the first two years the courses are delivered in English while in the last two years international students take classes in Chinese. This model can achieve kill-two-birds with one stone effect. On the one hand, students can start their major directly after they come to China. On the other hand, students have more time to learn Chinese before they actually need to study in Chinese. 3. The Goal of This Program Editor Notes: Students can not only master professional skills and well informed about knowledge of computer science and technology, but also Chinese language, culture in this program. This program is set to train qualified computer professionals with basic theory and knowledge of computer science and technology and also good research ability, application ability and innovative ability . Graduates are well equipped with professional skills and well informed about knowledge of computer science and technology, as well as Chinese language, culture. 4. Language Requirement Editor Notes: International students are required to pass HSK 3 before graduation. English-speaking international students don't need pass HSK (Chinese proficiency test) to start degree programs. However they need to pass HSK 3 at the end of second year of their degree programs. 5. Introduction of Zhejiang A & F University Editor Notes: The first employment rate of undergraduate students is always more than 90% and in the forefront of Zhejiang universities. Founded in 1958, Zhejiang A & F University (ZAFU) is a comprehensive university directly under the auspices of Zhejiang Province offering Bachelor and Masters degrees in agriculture, technology, science, literature, management, law, economics, medicine, etc. and enrolling international students. ZAFU, located in Lin'an City (west of the popular tourist destination Hangzhou) has Yijin and East Lake campuses covering almost 167 hectares with 550,000 square meters of building space. Its modern buildings and facilities in a setting of great natural beauty, surrounded by mountains and water, make ZAFU a most suitable place for learning, teaching, and conducting research. The campus combined with the botanical garden comprise an ecological environment with functions of teaching, scientific research, and biodiversity conservation. Learn More>> 6.
